reason: Full concept review verified the pinned base, auto candidate, receipt, and source-candidate hashes and compared all three approved patches with the complete candidate and diff. All three IDs and the dated source route are present, but an unchanged billing-cycle-anchor bullet still makes a universal credit-proration claim that conflicts with the new bounded custom-date rule.
required_changes: In `## Billing cycle anchor behavior`, qualify `- Moving cancel date closer: shortens anchor to match; creates credit proration`. The November guide's anchor passage gives a -30 USD credit as an example without proration suppression, while its custom-date rule allows disabling prorations for `cancel_at` within the current period. State the anchor effect and make the credit an example or conditional outcome, with the within-period suppression qualification directly in this bullet; do not leave an unconditional credit claim elsewhere on the concept page.
